description: Header file defining the 'phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator' class, which decorates a PUSCH processor with metrics collection and notification capabilities within a 5G NR PHY layer implementation.

classes.name: phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for PUSCH processor that adds metrics collection and reporting functionality.

methods.name: phy_metrics_pusch_processor_decorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a base processor and a metrics notifier.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the process method to add metrics measurement, timing, and notification around the underlying processor's processing.

methods.name: on_uci
methods.description: Handles UCI reporting, records timing, and forwards the notification.

methods.name: on_sch
methods.description: Handles SCH reporting, records timing, and forwards the notification.

methods.name: notify_metrics
methods.description: Collects and reports processing metrics if processing is complete.
